calculation_source:
import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

source = Path('runs/kaggle_original_final_resume_output')
out = Path('results/kaggle/original-resume-v2')
pull = Path('results/training/kaggle_original_final_resume.json')
submitted = json.loads(pull.read_text())
assert submitted['version'] == 2 and submitted['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
pair = json.loads((source / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
assert pair['exit_codes'] == [0, 0] and pair['checkpoint_updates'] == 300
previous = Path('results/kaggle/original-v1')
prior = list(previous.rglob('dice/qwen3.5-4b-grpo.jsonl'))
assert len(prior) == 1
assert len(prior[0].read_bytes().splitlines()) == 120
assert (source / 'resume-dice/results/raw/dice/qwen3.5-4b-grpo.jsonl').read_bytes().startswith(prior[0].read_bytes())
inputs, outputs, cohorts = {}, {}, {}
for src in source.rglob('*'):
    if src.is_file() and src.suffix != '.jsonl':
        target = out / src.relative_to(source)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(src, target)
        inputs[str(src)] = file_sha256(src)
for game in ('dice', 'cards'):
    runtime = json.loads((source / f'resume-{game}/runtime.json').read_text())
    assert runtime['status'] == 'completed'
    for label in ('qwen3.5-4b-grpo', 'bayes'):
        raw = source / f'resume-{game}/results/raw/{game}/{label}.jsonl'
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()]
        assert sorted(row['seed'] for row in rows) == list(range(200, 400))
        assert all(row['game'] == game and row['player'] == label and len(row['rounds']) == 6 for row in rows)
        if label != 'bayes':
            assert all(row['provenance']['model_revision'] == pair['model_revision'] for row in rows)
            new_rows = rows[120:] if game == 'dice' else rows
            assert all(row['provenance']['config']['adapter_sha256'] == pair['adapter_sha256'] for row in new_rows)
        inputs[str(raw)] = file_sha256(raw)
        target = out / f'qwen3.5-4b-grpo/results/raw/{game}/{label}.jsonl'
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(raw, target)
        cohorts[str(target)] = {'episodes': len(rows), 'seeds': [200, 399], 'sha256': file_sha256(target)}
for path in out.rglob('*'):
    if path.is_file(): outputs[str(path)] = file_sha256(path)
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain completed frozen original GRPO continuation without aggregate inspection'}, pair['model_revision']),
     'download_receipt': str(pull), 'kernel': submitted['metadata']['id'], 'version': 2,
     'input_sha256': inputs, 'output_sha256': outputs, 'cohorts': cohorts,
     'prior_dice_file': str(prior[0]), 'prior_dice_sha256': file_sha256(prior[0]), 'prior_120_dice_bytes_preserved': True,
     'seed_correction': 'results/training/original_seed_correction.json',
     'legacy_provenance_note': 'The original 120 dice rows do not record an adapter hash. Their bytes are preserved; resumed rows record the downloaded frozen adapter hash. Do not retrofit missing legacy provenance.',
     'calculation_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
     'interpretation': 'Frozen trained adapter; only missing episodes evaluated. Original 120 dice episodes remain byte-identical. No aggregate held-out scores inspected.'}
Path('results/training/kaggle_original_final_resume_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json'); ledger = json.loads(p.read_text())
for session in ledger['sessions']:
    if session['kernel'] == r['kernel'] and session['version'] == 2:
        session.update(status='completed_outputs_retrieved', script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'],
                       hours=pair['wall_seconds'] / 3600, hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.',
                       observed_complete_at=submitted['polls'][-1]['at'], result_file=str(out / 'pair_runtime.json'))
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Retained both complete 200-episode GRPO cohorts; prior 120 dice bytes preserved; scores sealed.')
interpretation: Frozen trained adapter; only missing episodes evaluated. Original 120 dice episodes remain byte-identical. No aggregate held-out scores inspected.
